release_notes:
Improved order search and order detail layout

- Admin order search and the order list now find and show the correct
  IMEI/Serial for services that collect it through a custom field
  instead of the standard IMEI box — previously these orders wouldn't
  turn up in a search at all.
- The order detail popup now shows the submitted order info on the
  left and the supplier's response on the right, making it easier to
  read at a glance.
